extDescription.message:
A minimalist new tab page that replaces your browser default. All data stays local — zero privacy risk.

Key features:
· Bing daily wallpaper: HD image with fade-in animation and copyright info, custom background upload, reset to Bing
· Multi-engine search: Google, Baidu, Bing, Sogou, 360, DuckDuckGo, quick switch via dropdown, Enter to search
· Bookmark card grid: renders Chrome/Edge bookmarks as large cards by folder, with collapse/expand, rename and delete
· Drag sorting: reorder cards and move across folders, synced with browser bookmarks
· Customizable glass effect: adjust blur and opacity for buttons, search box and bookmarks, real-time
· Offline instant: wallpapers and favicons cached locally, zero network wait on next open
